prefix: One continuous shot from a locked-off camera; the room, the light and the framing stay exactly the same from the first to the last frame.
suffix: The change happens only through real physical actions of the body, the hands, the mitre, the beard and the cape. No crossfade, no dissolve, no fade, no double exposure, no morphing or melting face, no cut, nothing slides or pops into view. For the first {t1} seconds nobody can tell who is underneath: the face either stays Sinterklaas or stays hidden. The reveal happens fast in the last {t2} seconds and the clip lands exactly on the final frame, holding that pose for the last moment.
negative_prompt: crossfade, dissolve, fade, fade to black, fade to white, double exposure, ghosting, transparency, morphing face, melting face, face warping, cut, jump cut, scene change, slide in, wipe, sudden appearance, teleport, flicker, camera movement, zoom, blur, extra fingers, deformed hands, text, subtitles, watermark
person_default: the person from the final frame

kostuum.uit: In the same moment the red cape and robe are pulled off and thrown out of frame, revealing the clothes underneath.

varianten.uitleg: Rustig. De Sint zet de mijter af en houdt hem voor zijn gezicht; daarachter gebeurt de wissel. Dan snel mijter weg en baard eraf.
varianten.prompt: For the first {t1} seconds Sinterklaas slowly lifts his tall red mitre off his head with both hands and lowers it in front of his face, so his whole face disappears behind it; he holds it there for a moment, teasing. In the last {t2} seconds he quickly drops the mitre out of frame and in the same motion pulls the white beard down and away. {costume} Now we see {person}, who settles into the exact pose of the final frame.

varianten.uitleg: De Sint plukt plagerig aan zijn baard en rukt hem dan in een keer omhoog over zijn gezicht eraf; de mijter valt door de schok.
varianten.prompt: For the first {t1} seconds Sinterklaas leans towards the camera with a mischievous look, strokes his long white beard and tugs at it a few times, as if testing whether it is real. In the last {t2} seconds he rips the beard off in one rough, fast yank, sweeping it up across his face, and the mitre tumbles off his head from the jolt. {costume} Now we see {person}, laughing, landing in the exact pose of the final frame.

In the last {t2} seconds the figure spins back around quickly, without mitre and beard. {costume} It is {person}, stepping straight into the exact pose and position of the final frame.

varianten.uitleg: De Sint maakt een plechtige buiging zodat de mijter zijn gezicht afdekt, en komt met een ruk overeind; mijter glijdt eraf, baard zit in zijn handen.

In the last {t2} seconds the figure straightens up in one quick movement: the mitre slides off backwards and the beard comes away in the hands. {costume} Standing there is {person}, in the exact pose of the final frame.

In the last {t2} seconds the beard comes free, the hand drops away and the head comes up quickly. {costume} It is {person}, ending in the exact pose of the final frame.

varianten.uitleg: Past bij het dobbelen: de Sint schudt alsof hij zelf de beker is; bij het stoppen vliegen mijter en baard eraf.
